stack: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript, Node.js 20 Express, Python 3.11 FastAPI + Celery, PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, Docker Compose, Helm
description: A minimal web‑based AI‑enabled simulation platform with Auth0 OAuth, scenario CRUD, real‑time telemetry via WebSocket, AI helper routes, and containerised services orchestrated with Docker‑Compose (dev) and a single Helm chart (prod).

files.purpose: Defines development containers for frontend, backend, simulation service, PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO, and optional Auth0 mock.
GitHub Actions CI pipeline: linting, unit tests, Docker image build, and Helm deployment.
Helm chart metadata for the production deployment.
Default configuration values (image tags, resource limits, ingress, secrets).
Kubernetes Deployment template for all services (frontend, backend, simulation).
Project overview, quick‑start commands, and contribution guidelines.
Node dependencies and scripts for the React SPA.
TypeScript compiler configuration for the frontend.
Vite build configuration.
Root React component that sets up routing and authentication context.
Generated TypeScript API client based on the OpenAPI spec.
Node dependencies and scripts for the Express API gateway.
TypeScript compiler configuration for the backend.
Creates and configures the Express application, registers middleware and routes.
Auth0 callback endpoint and token handling (optional PKCE flow).
CRUD API for user scenarios.
Endpoints to launch simulations and query status.
AI helper routes that call OpenAI SDK (template generation, explanation, optimization).
WebSocket server that subscribes to Redis telemetry channels and forwards messages to clients.
Express middleware for JWT verification using Auth0 JWKS.
Prisma data model defining User, Scenario, Simulation, AIRequest tables.
Container image for the Python simulation service.
Python dependencies: FastAPI, Uvicorn, Celery[redis], Redis, Pydantic, Boto3, NumPy.
FastAPI entry point exposing /run, health, and /metrics endpoints.
Celery task that executes a simulation, publishes telemetry to Redis, and stores results in MinIO.
Generates the TypeScript client (frontend/src/api/client.ts) from the OpenAPI specification.
